question: The value of the expression \(\left(\frac{-1+\sqrt{-3}}2\right)^n+\left(\frac{-1-\sqrt{-3}}2\right)^n\) is

options.A: 3 when \(n\) is a positive multiple of 3, and 0 when \(n\) is any other positive integer
options.B: 2 when \(n\) is a positive multiple of 3, and −1 when \(n\) is any other positive integer
options.C: 1 when \(n\) is a positive multiple of 3, and −2 when \(n\) is any other positive integer

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
